pr_title: network: do not require DHCPv6 addresses when UseAddress=no

issue_context.title: systemd-networkd interfaces remain configuring when UseAddress=false
issue_context.body:
**systemd version the issue has been seen with**
 > systemd 248 (248-1-arch)
+PAM +AUDIT -SELINUX -APPARMOR -IMA +SMACK +SECCOMP +GCRYPT +GNUTLS +OPENSSL +ACL +BLKID +CURL +ELFUTILS +FIDO2 +IDN2 -IDN +IPTC +KMOD +LIBCRYPTSETUP +LIBFDISK +PCRE2 -PWQUALITY +P11KIT -QRENCODE +BZIP2 +LZ4 +XZ +ZLIB +ZSTD +XKBCOMMON +UTMP -SYSVINIT default-hierarchy=unified               

<!-- **NOTE:** Do not submit bug reports about anything but the two most recently released *major* systemd versions upstream! -->
<!--           If there have been multiple stable releases for that major version, please consider updating to a recent one before reporting an issue. -->
<!--           When using a distro package, please make sure that the version reported is meaningful for upstream. -->
<!-- See https://github.com/systemd/systemd-stable/releases for the list of most recent releases. -->
<!-- For older version please use distribution trackers (see https://systemd.io/CONTRIBUTING#filing-issues). -->

**Used distribution**
 > Arch Linux

**Linux kernel version used** (`uname -a`)
<!-- Make sure to enclose the pasted kernel version in `backticks`, so that
     GitHub doesn't convert the `#` character typically included in it into a
     reference to old GitHub issues. -->
 > Linux hostname 5.11.0-seblu #1 SMP PREEMPT Tue Feb 16 15:56:00 CET 2021 x86_64 GNU/Linux

**CPU architecture issue was seen on**
 > x86_64

**Steps to reproduce the problem**
A very simple double interface situation where eth0 is providing the PD to a dummy interface.

#### eth0.network
```ini
[Match]
Name=eth0

[Network]
Address=1.2.3.4/24
Address=1::2/64
Gateway=1.2.3.1
DHCP=ipv6

[DHCPv4]
# Used by DHCPv6 but not allowed in DHCPv6
ClientIdentifier=duid-only
DUIDType=link-layer
DUIDRawData=xxx

[DHCPv6]
UseAddress=false
WithoutRA=solicit
```

#### dummy0.netdev
```ini
[NetDev]
Name=dummy0
Kind=dummy
```

#### dummy0.network
```ini
[Match]
Name=dummy0
[Network]
IPv6PrefixDelegation=dhcpv6
```

**Unexpected behaviour you saw**
Interface `eth0` remain configuring in networkctl 

```
# networkctl 
IDX LINK   TYPE     OPERATIONAL SETUP       
1 lo     loopback carrier     unmanaged
2 eth0   ether    routable    configuring
3 dummy0 ether    routable    configured 
```

Running in debug log level, shows `link_check_ready()` is unhappy because there is no dynamic assignment. Which is the purpose of UseAddress=false.
```
# SYSTEMD_LOG_LEVEL=debug /usr/lib/systemd/systemd-networkd
sd-device-monitor: No permission to stat PID1's netns, unable to determine if we are in host netns: Permission denied
Bus bus-api-network: changing state UNSET → OPENING
sd-bus: starting bus bus-api-network by connecting to /run/dbus/system_bus_socket...
Bus bus-api-network: changing state OPENING → AUTHENTICATING
Registering bus object implementation for path=/org/freedesktop/LogControl1 iface=org.freedesktop.LogControl1
timestamp of '/etc/systemd/network' changed
dummy0: loaded dummy
dummy0: Creating
...
eth0: Configuring route: dst: n/a, src: n/a, gw: fe80::x:x, prefsrc: n/a, scope: global, table: main(254), proto: ra, type: unicast, nexthop: 0
eth0: Setting NDisc routes.
eth0: Removing old NDisc information obtained from fe80::x:x.
eth0: link_check_ready(): DHCP4, DHCP6 or IPv4LL is enabled but no dynamic address is assigned yet.
eth0: NDisc routes set.
eth0: Removing old NDisc information obtained from fe80::x:x.
eth0: link_check_ready(): DHCP4, DHCP6 or IPv4LL is enabled but no dynamic address is assigned yet.
...
eth0: link_check_ready(): DHCP4, DHCP6 or IPv4LL is enabled but no dynamic address is assigned yet.
```

Despite these messages, IPv6 PD works.

**Expected behaviour you didn't see**
```
# networkctl 
IDX LINK   TYPE     OPERATIONAL SETUP       
1 lo     loopback carrier     unmanaged
2 eth0   ether    routable    configured
3 dummy0 ether    routable    configured 
```
comments: Ah, indeed. Thanks. I will try to fix this next week.

Great news ! 

As the [provider](https://documentation.online.net/en/dedicated-server/network/ipv6/prefix) where tests are made also provide an *IA_NA* address with the *IA_PD* prefix, I noticed there is the same issue with the "regular" DHCPv6 addresses. It's not only related to prefix delegation.

**A similar eth0 configuration, without prefix delegation on dummy interface:**
```ini
[Match]
Name=eth0

[Network]
Address=<static v4>/24
Address=<static v6 from the dhcp prefix>/128
Gateway=<static gw>
DHCP=ipv6

[DHCPv6]
UseAddress=false
WithoutRA=solicit
```

**Same output in networkctl:**
```
# networkctl 
IDX LINK  TYPE     OPERATIONAL SETUP      
  1 lo    loopback carrier     unmanaged
  2 eth0  ether    routable    configuring
```

**Same output in debug logs:**

The requirement here, is to get the lease for the *IA_NA* address, which tell the router to forward all packet to the *IA_NA* /64 prefix to our host. Then, we can define which interface address we want statically.

review_comments: link_dhcp6_enabled already does the assert… I think it's fine to leave it out.
